g.title: cluster_heads
g.text: heads · on every layer · one small network per output

g.title: cluster_loss
g.text: Loss · training only · every layer, summed

g.title: VIT
g.text: pixels only: no camera matrix enters it
tubelet 2: the two frames make one 16×32 grid

g.title: TOK
g.text: tokens-vit-v1 · each token carries the ViT's own position code

g.title: MEM
g.text: 0.26 M · the values: what each token says

g.title: L2I
g.text: K·[R|t] at 0.4 scale, then the crop and resize
ego point → pixel of the 512×256 image · 4×4

g.title: RAY
g.text: each token's ray at 16 depths, 1–60 m · MLP 48 → 256 → d
added to the keys only: where each token looks
NAVSIM's camera barely varies (0.5°): in effect a fixed code

g.title: CA
g.text: q = a + pos · k = memory + rays · v = memory

g.title: QRY
g.text: learnt slots (DETR) · points start uniform in x 2–50, |y| < 30, z 0
32 of v1's 64 start outside the camera's view

g.title: POS
g.text: 3 → 256 → d · gives each slot a place to look from

g.title: SA
g.text: q = k = a + pos · v = a · slots see each other: no duplicates

g.title: HUN
g.text: each target trains one slot; the rest learn "none"

g.title: OUT
g.text: a list of agents: class, 3D box, velocity, 1 s path
each with its cross-attention: where it looked

g.title: HR->POS
g.text: next layer's reference = this centre, detached

g.title: LOS
g.text: divided by the batch's targets (path: by its valid steps)
no gradient leaves the side-car: the ViT is frozen

g.title: TGT
g.text: veh · ped · cyc within 50 m whose centre projects into the image
